caption: The whole text is one Result relation: unit U1 (Ravi missed the bus) is the nucleus cause, unit U2 (he reached the office late) is the satellite result. The only visible ties are the pronoun he pointing back to Ravi and the cue As a result — delete the cue and readers still infer Result, but now nothing marks it.
